# G-04 exceptions list (docs/security-probes/G-04-design.md §3). Decisions, not a snapshot.
# id | type | canary_kind | surface | case | part | reason | decided by
# Every change to this file is security-relevant. E-09 is withdrawn (not copied).

B-02 | baseline | credential_url | S*:dlq_entries | C-10 | any | FINDING (first run on main): a webhook delivery that exhausts into the DLQ stores the target URL WITH its userinfo and query token in dlq_entries (the T-2606 class: a credential URL kept in a failure record). Not fixed in the probe task; the fix is to store the origin only | T-2628

Not fixed in the probe task; the fix is to print the origin only | T-2628
